text:
sara: hey team  kicking off a quick sync on the docs style + naming cleanup. found a few inconsistencies bubbling up in SDK snippets and the migration guide. will drop PRs in a sec; looking for a fast pass from docs and an eng glance for API names.

jon: thanks. high level, are we changing canonical API snake_case names or just example parameter casing?

sara: canonical stays snake_case. change is about harmonizing examples and the wording in the style guide. decision: examples remain idiomatic per language, but we add a clear note in the style guide and the migration checklist.

emma: good. can you list the specific files/areas? i'll triage link and example fixes.

sara: PRs:
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5230 - sdk-examples-unify (JS/py/Go snippets)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5231 - migration-guide-param-clarify (upgrade notes + excerpt examples)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5232 - glossary-vocab-cleanup (add: "key-value cache", "prefix caching")
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233 - embeddings-links-and-anchors (fix internal anchors + external link swap)

ryan: i'll pick up 5233 (links). embeddings doc had an anchor renamed in last structure change. should we add redirects for the old anchors?

sara: yes please add redirects in /docs/_redirects for the most common anchors; leave a short comment in the PR describing the mapping.

jon: for 5230, how are we testing the snippets? do we run the JS example in CI?

emma: propose a lightweight smoke test: run the examples with a fake API key env and assert they exit cleanly. add to the docs-ci matrix as a separate job.

sara: agreed. snippet ci plan: add examples/ci-smoke.js and a GitHub Action step that runs node for JS and pytest for Python examples. keep time under 30s.

ryan: copy on redirects and CI. quick style question: error message tone  should system messages use sentence case or Title Case?

sara: sentence case. follow the microcopy guide: short, direct, no contractions in system-generated text. update noted in 5231.

jon: small naming convention: internal SDK param names use snake_case in the API reference, but our JS snippets should show camelCase to match common usage. make sure we surface that in the migration guide with explicit examples mapping old -> new.

emma: i'll add a tiny table snippet in the migration guide:
```
API param    JS example
model_size   modelSize
prompt_text  promptText
```

ryan: perfect. i'll also run a grep for "KV cache" vs "key-value" and normalize to "key-value (KV) cache" at first mention. then use "KV cache" after.

sara: thanks. docs-bot: please ensure at least one docs approval and one eng approval on PRs touching SDK snippets.

docs-bot: noted. lint rule reminder: docs-snippet CI must pass and at least one human reviewer from docs + eng is required for SDK changes.

jon: timeline? i can review 5230 tomorrow morning.

emma: i can finish link fixes today and start migration guide edits.

ryan: i'll queue the redirect patch and the glossary updates; will add cross-refs to runtime caching pages.

sara: great. checklist: 
- [ ] update style guide paragraph about canonical param names + idiomatic snippets
- [ ] harmonize SDK examples across languages (PR 5230)
- [ ] migration guide clarifications + example mapping (PR 5231)
- [ ] glossary entries + runtime cross-refs (PR 5232)
- [ ] fix anchors + redirects (PR 5233)
- [ ] add snippets smoke tests in docs CI

emma: i'll mark 5233 ready after the redirect patch.

jon: ping me when 5230 is ready for review; i'll focus on the JS snippets and the CI step.

ryan: quick note: when adding redirects, please include the original anchor path in the PR description so we can track common 404s later.

sara: will do. thanks all  i'll follow up with a merge order suggestion once CI is green.
